scope.summary: Implement fit map projection from 3D fitted garment vertices back onto the 2D pattern panel UV space, producing a texture-resolution heatmap image per panel that can be displayed in the 2D pattern editor view alongside the original panel outline
acceptance_criteria: fit_map_to_2d_pattern(panel_3d: &Panel3D, uv_islands: &[UvIsland], heatmap_values: &[f32]) produces an RGBA texture in UV space (512x512 minimum) with per-texel interpolated heatmap values
The 2D panel view in the Tailor frontend shows a toggle for fit map overlay (stress | strain | pressure | off)
When enabled, the heatmap texture is composited over the panel outline in the 2D editor
A model can request the raw heatmap image via GET /api/tailor/garments/{gar_id}/panels/{panel_id}/fit-map?mode=stress returning an image/png ArtifactStore ref

All operator-facing scope is implemented in src/frontend/handshake_native with native wgpu/egui, AccessKit author_id, Argus inspection/steering/capture, and no Tailor React, Tauri-command, WebView, data-testid-only, or rendered-PNG frontend path.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without 2D fit map projection, an operator must mentally correlate a 3D heatmap region to a specific pattern panel location. The 2D projection is the actionable view that tells the pattern maker exactly which seam, dart, or panel edge to adjust. Its absence significantly slows pattern correction cycles.
